Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE new KFB 3x2 landscape transparent PNG character sheet, EXACTLY SIX unique absurd-surreal weird claymation INK BLOB MONSTERS, a fictional retro Der Verein zum zweiten Aufschlag sports team. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets: image1 rounded sculpted whole ink-body material; image2 handcrafted prop/material craft. Do not copy source costume, eyes or repeated grins. 1920s-to-1970s retro tennis club, ivory and faded sage cotton accessories, wooden racquets, no human anatomy. Warm offbeat physical cartoon acting with satirical vulnerable personalities, no glossy Pixar-human clichés.
BODY LOCK: Every character is one complete continuous FOOTLESS charcoal-black ink splat with subtle dark violet sheen, softly rounded thick asymmetric lobes, a few droplets, huge face directly in goo and short goo hands. Upright facing camera, full silhouette. NO human torso, legs, feet, trouser anatomy, cropped bust, animal body, alternate material body. Sports are expressed through hands, facial acting and props. Costumes are SMALL collar/shoulder/front-bib accents, bare ink dominates. Premium handmade plasticine fingerprint texture, rounded rich volumes, softly lit upper left. Every visible eye has WHITE/IVORY sclera around RED iris around BLACK pupil; thick fully filled purple-black eyelids. Helmets/visors do not cover eyes. Female-read cues subtly sculpted lids/lashes/quiff, no breasts or human hips. Six different mouth actions and bodily shapes. Teeth ONLY descend from upper gum INSIDE open mouth; never on outside lower lip, closed mouths toothless. No human pink lipstick.
TOP LEFT — Elsa Ersteraufschlag; female-read. Tall teardrop blob, swept ink curl and subtle lashes, wide delighted white eyes and sharp asymmetrical two-upper-tooth grin; ivory headband and sage sailor-style tiny collar; holds short wooden racquet upright and one cream felt ball high in other hand.
TOP MIDDLE — Gustav Grundlinie; male-read. Broad stubborn bell-shaped blob, bushy ink brow, closed flat sulky mouth; sage sweatband and small ivory knit collar; wooden racquet held low across one flank, strings clearly visible not covering body/face.
TOP RIGHT — Nelly Netzgewinn; female-read. Compact square splat, fluttering side ink crest, lashed eyes glancing sideways and nervous toothless smile; tiny ivory visor and sage neckerchief; hugs a little folded three-square net in one hand, wooden racquet at side.
BOTTOM LEFT — Viktor Rückhand; male-read. Lean reverse-comma blob, one high skeptical eyelid and crooked closed victorious smirk; sage narrow collar and ivory wristbands; wooden racquet held backhand across lower side with both short goo hands, not face.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — Bodo Ballwechsel; male-read. Round wobbly upright blob, exhausted raised eyebrows, tiny toothless panting mouth; sagging ivory headband and small sage collar; embraces vintage open cylindrical ball tin with three visible cream tennis balls.
BOTTOM RIGHT — Sir Satzverlust; male-read. Tall oval splat, deeply weary half-lidded eyes and magnificent asymmetrical downturned mouth; tiny ivory cable-knit cricket-style collar with sage edge, little moustache-shaped INK upper lip not hair; holds a broken wooden racquet with ONE clean sag in string bed, body whole.
COMPOSITION: landscape 1536x1024, three equal columns by two equal rows, equal generously sized character scale in BOTH rows. Each silhouette and all props fit approximately 450x440px within its 512x512 logical cell with at least32px clean transparent gutters. Keep all6 substantial, no tiny bottom row, no automatic excessive padding, no overlap or clipping. No ground, floor, field, court, scenelet, shadows disc, labels, lettering, jersey numbers, logos, real brands, team names in pixels, grid lines, frame, scenery. True transparent background. Individual actors must also read alone. Restrained one/two bold coherent identity anchors; avoid extra clutter or inherited tongue gags.
